p.em: Every toast, error and empty state, and what to do about it.
'Nothing here': the page for a link that does not exist or belongs to something you cannot see.

tr.th: It means, and what to do

tr.td: Your access request is with your lead. Follow it in My workspace.
Already yours · You already have access to …; open it from Discover.
You asked for something your role already opens. Nothing was sent; open it from Discover.
Already asked · Your request for … is with your lead; there is nothing to send again.
Your earlier request is still pending. Nothing was sent again; follow it under My workspace → Your requests.
A brief names the team that owns it. You are in no team yet; ask your lead to add you, then start here. · You are in no team yet. Ask your lead to add you; a brief needs the team that owns it.
The Build page, and the brief's Team field, when the platform lists you in no team. Ask your lead to add you; the brief waits.
Your sign-off is recorded on the hub. An engineer commits it.
Playground key rotated. · The previous key stops working in 10 minutes.
Update the key where you use it.

td.code: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

tr.td: The token expired or was revoked. Sign in; you return to the same page.

td.code: Your role does not allow this.

tr.td: Not open to your role. Request it from the listing, or ask your lead.
That item does not exist or you cannot see it. · Nothing here · That page does not exist, or it belongs to something you cannot see.
A wrong link, or something outside your access.

td.code: This was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.

tr.td: The brief or record was updated elsewhere since you opened it. Reload; your last saved state is intact.
A field is invalid. The field is marked with what is wrong.

td.code: You are sending requests faster than the platform allows. Wait a moment and try again.

tr.td: A per-person limit. Wait the seconds shown; nobody else is affected.
The platform hit a problem. It has been recorded; try again in a moment. and a line such as HTTP 503 · request 7f3a…
Something on the platform failed. Quote the request id to support; it matches a line in the logs.
Loading the catalog… · Opening the listing… · Reading the shelf… · Loading your briefs… · Loading your workspace… · Opening the assistant…
Waiting on the platform. If it lasts, the matching "could not be loaded" line appears with a request id.

td.code: The platform could not resolve your account.

tr.td: You signed in, but the platform has no record for you. Your lead adds your group to the identity map.

td.code: This conversation has reached 200 turns; start a new conversation.

tr.td: The assistant's error banner shows the platform's sentence first. A conversation has a ceiling of 200 turns; press + for a fresh one, the old one stays in the list.

td.code: Your role no longer opens this assistant.

tr.td: The same banner, when an entitlement was removed since you opened the conversation. Ask for access from the assistant's listing.
